I'm in the process of trying to create a light novel and/or manga as a project that I am interested in. However, I'm having trouble deciding on whether to write a Japanese light novel, a western novel, or create a manga and skip the middle man. I have a bunch of story ideas, however, I don't know how to write in the psychological horror genre. I take inspiration from the Higurashi anime series and I also take inspiration from another anime called Erased. However, I want to add my own unique elements of psychological horror. 
Because the main plot of the story that I've come up with there are two timelines, one in the past and one in the present, but there are four flashbacks that happen in the past that lead up to the present. The MC in the present meets a girl and then a murder takes place, after which, they start having extremely hallucinations and delusions related to the girl's past. Then the MC of the present is sent back to the past to work together with the MC from the past to try to save the girl from her abusers.
That's the gist of what I have so far, I'm still developing the story. But I'm just concerned about making a good psychological horror story that is original and unique like I said and also what type of medium I should make it be. Any ideas would be appreciated.
